official_sources.verified_fact: Python warns that untrusted ZIP archives must be inspected before extraction because absolute paths and parent-directory components can create files outside the target path.
official_sources.limitation: The application still has to enforce its own path, duplicate-name, encryption and special-file policy.

official_sources.verified_fact: Python documents decompression bombs as a resource-exhaustion risk that can consume disk space during extraction.
official_sources.limitation: The standard library does not choose project-specific per-file or compression-ratio limits.

official_sources.verified_fact: Python notes that ZIP archives can contain duplicate member names and exposes ZipInfo objects to disambiguate them.
official_sources.limitation: This pipeline rejects case-insensitive duplicate names instead of selecting one.

official_sources.verified_fact: GDAL GeoTIFF normally considers PAM, internal tags, TAB, worldfile and XML sources in priority order and allows the accepted sources to be restricted with GDAL_GEOREF_SOURCES.
official_sources.limitation: The runtime must set INTERNAL and reject conflicting sidecars before opening target rasters.

official_sources.verified_fact: GDAL documents path-traversal detection for parent-directory patterns and exposes runtime configuration controls.
official_sources.limitation: Archive member validation remains necessary before GDAL sees extracted files.

official_sources.verified_fact: Rasterio documents that masked arrays mark invalid cells and that external .msk sidecars can override nodata metadata.
official_sources.limitation: The pipeline rejects external mask and georeferencing sidecars and requires the target cell to be finite and unmasked.

official_sources.verified_fact: EA time-stamped DTM tiles are GeoTIFF rasters in 5 km ZIP files at 0.25, 0.5, 1 or 2 metre resolution, in metres referenced to Ordnance Survey Newlyn and aligned to the OS Grid; survey metadata records date, transformation and geoidal model.
official_sources.limitation: The selected object, archive bytes, TIFF bytes and metadata row must still reconcile exactly.

official_sources.verified_fact: EA DSM includes buildings, vegetation and other surface objects, while the DTM product removes surface objects to model terrain.
official_sources.limitation: DSM is diagnostic only and cannot replace native DTM elevation sampling.
